title: Coordinate independence
statement: A function $q:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ is independent of coordinate $i$ if replacing the $i$th coordinate of any input by any sign leaves the value of $q$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to the reals
